text.tspan: - Use film capacitors for all in audio path, <= 5%
- Use THIN film resistors for all in audio path, <= 0.5%
- R6 and C3 should physically close to CV input pin 2 of VCAs
- The NTC thermistor (TH1) has a nominal resistance 47k (@25C)
- CV range rescaling (gain factor) from 3.3V to 0.5V:
- The -2.5V reference is to offset the CV while rescaling it.
- The raw CV is in range 0-3.3V
- Just scaling it to range of 0.5V would give 0 to -0.5V,
- But we need to move up by 73mV to get -427mV to +73mV.
And the fraction reaching the summing node is
By superposition, that gets added to the scaled voltage
to move it up 73mV, bringing it into the right range.
- The VCA drifts by 0.33% of the gain per deg. C.
- I.e. at -20dB gain, chip warming by 15C gives
= +439R / degC, make CV smaller, to cancel temp.
- This 47k NTC thermistor does 447R per C (close)
- Paralleling it with R4 makes it more linear
(by default NTC is exponental, R4 helps extremes)
